# Setup
```{r}
root.dir <- "/Users/pengja/PennNeurosurgery Dropbox/Jackie Peng/SilverbushLab/Projects/Jackie_post-mortem/"
figures.dir <- paste0(root.dir, "Figures/", "Figure 3/")
supp.figures.dir <- paste0(root.dir, "Figures/", "Figure 3/", "Supplemental/")

suppressMessages(suppressWarnings(source(paste0(root.dir, "Code/", 'helper_functions.R'))))

seurat.obj <- readRDS(paste0(root.dir, "ProcessedData/", "my_data/", "autopsy/", "all_postmortem_samples_cellbender.FALSE_denoise.heat.shock.signature_postmortem.sensitive_postmortem.signature_filter.FALSE_batch.correction.None/", "seurat_objects/all_postmortem_samples_w_celltypes.velmeshev2019.RDS"))

seurat.obj$cell.id <- colnames(seurat.obj)
colnames(seurat.obj@meta.data)

metadata <- seurat.obj@meta.data %>% dplyr::select(cell.id, celltype.by.cluster, predicted.annotation_l2.w.neftel)

write.table(metadata, paste0(root.dir, "ProcessedData/", "my_data/", "autopsy/", "all_postmortem_samples_cellbender.FALSE_denoise.heat.shock.signature_postmortem.sensitive_postmortem.signature_filter.FALSE_batch.correction.None/", "seurat_objects/all_postmortem_samples_w_celltypes.velmeshev2019_metadata.tsv"), row.names = T, col.names = T, quote = F, sep = "\t")


seurat.obj.facs <- subset(seurat.obj, subset = (method == "FACS"))
seurat.obj.gbm <- subset(seurat.obj.facs, subset = (patient.desc %in% c("GBM 1", "GBM 2")))
seurat.obj.gbm.high.quality <- subset(seurat.obj.gbm, subset = low.quality.by.qc == FALSE)

library(infercnv)
set.seed(123)
```

# Supplemental: Postmortem signatures in this study's data
```{r}
seurat.obj$sample.desc.method <- factor(seurat.obj$sample.desc.method, levels = sample.descs.by.method)

for (y in c("postmortem.sensitive", "postmortem.signature", "heat.shock.signature", "postmortem.glial")) {
  
  y.title <- case_when(
    y == "postmortem.sensitive" ~ "Living enriched",
    y == "postmortem.signature" ~ "Postmortem enriched",
    y == "heat.shock.signature" ~ "Hypoxia heat shock",
    y == "postmortem.glial" ~ "Postmortem glial",
    TRUE ~ ""

      seurat.obj@meta.data,
```

# Supplemental: UMAP of P2 tumor edge (3 methods) and P2 distal uninvolved
Faceted by method and quality
```{r}
# no denoise
seurat.obj.original <- readRDS(paste0(root.dir, "ProcessedData/", "my_data/", "autopsy/", "all_postmortem_samples_cellbender.FALSE_denoise.FALSE_filter.FALSE_batch.correction.None/", "seurat_objects/all_postmortem_samples_w_celltypes.velmeshev2019.RDS"))


unique(seurat.obj$patient.section)
patient.section.use <- "P2 S16"
x.lim <- c(-40, 40)   
y.lim <- c(-40, 40) 

for (filter in c(F, T)) {
  
  for (denoise in c(F, T)) {
    
    if (filter) {
      seurat.obj.subset <- subset(seurat.obj.original, subset = patient.section == patient.section.use)
      seurat.obj.subset <- subset(seurat.obj.subset, subset = low.quality.by.qc == FALSE)
    } else {
      seurat.obj.subset <- subset(seurat.obj.original, subset = patient.section == patient.section.use)
    }
    
    
    seurat.obj.subset <- add.module.score(seurat.obj.subset, gene.signatures)
    
    seurat.obj.subset <- FindVariableFeatures(seurat.obj.subset)
    
    
    if (denoise) {
      seurat.obj.subset <- ScaleData(seurat.obj.subset, vars.to.regress = c("heat.shock.signature", "postmortem.sensitive", "postmortem.signature"))
    } else {
      seurat.obj.subset <- ScaleData(seurat.obj.subset)
    }
    
    set.seed(123)
    seurat.obj.subset <- RunPCA(seurat.obj.subset)
    ElbowPlot(seurat.obj.subset, ndims = 50)
    
    seurat.obj.subset <- RunUMAP(seurat.obj.subset, dims = 1:10)
    
    
    if (!filter) {
      mm <- mixing_metric_seurat(
        seurat.obj.subset,
        group.by = "low.quality.by.qc",
        metric = "seurat",
        k = 5,
        dims = 1:2
      )
      
      mean.mm.low.quality <- mm$mean
    }
    
    mm <- mixing_metric_seurat(
      seurat.obj.subset,
      group.by = "method",
      metric = "seurat",
      k = 5,
      dims = 1:2
    )
    
    mean.mm <- mm$mean
    
    
    # mixing metric by cell type
    celltype.mm <- list()
    weighted.mm <- 0
    for (celltype in unique(seurat.obj.subset$predicted.annotation_l2)) {
      
      mm <- mixing_metric_seurat(
        subset(seurat.obj.subset, subset = predicted.annotation_l2 == celltype),
        group.by = "method",
        metric = "seurat",
        k = 5,
        dims = 1:2
      )
      mean.mm.celltype <- mm$mean
      n.celltype <- length(mm$per_cell)
      celltype.mm[[celltype]] <- mean.mm.celltype
      
      # if (celltype == "Low quality") {
      #   next
      # }
      
      weighted.mm <- weighted.mm + n.celltype * mean.mm.celltype
    }
    weighted.mm <- weighted.mm / dim(seurat.obj.subset)[2]
    
    seurat.obj.subset$method <- factor(seurat.obj.subset$method, levels = sample.prep.methods)
    method.legend.labels <- get.count.labels(seurat.obj.subset$method, sample.prep.method.colors)
    p1 <- DimPlot(seurat.obj.subset, group.by = "method", label=F, shuffle=T, raster=F) + 
      ggtitle(paste0("Method")) + 
      umap.axes +
      method.legend.labels

    seurat.obj.subset$predicted.annotation_l2.w.qc <- factor(seurat.obj.subset$predicted.annotation_l2.w.qc, levels = cell.types.anotation_l2.w.quality)
    predicted.annotation_l2.w.qc.legend.labels <- get.count.labels(seurat.obj.subset$predicted.annotation_l2.w.qc, cell.types.anotation_l2.w.quality.colors)
    p2 <- DimPlot(seurat.obj.subset, group.by = "predicted.annotation_l2.w.qc", label=F, shuffle=T, raster=F) + 
      ggtitle("Cell type") + 
      predicted.annotation_l2.w.qc.legend.labels + 
      umap.axes
    
    p <- p1 + p2
    pdf(paste0(supp.figures.dir, patient.section.use, "_UMAP_by_method_and_cell_type_denoise=", denoise, "_filter=", filter, ".pdf"), width = 18, height = 6)
    print(p)
    dev.off()  

   
    print(denoise)
    print(filter)
    print(mean.mm)
    print(mean.mm.low.quality)
    print(weighted.mm)
    print(celltype.mm)
    
    if (!filter) {
      print(celltype.mm["Low quality"])
    }
    
    
    # # PCA plot
    # pca.df <- Embeddings(seurat.obj.subset, "pca")[, 1:2] %>%
    #   as.data.frame() %>%
    #   cbind(
    #     annotation = seurat.obj.subset$predicted.annotation_l2.w.qc
    #   )
    # 
    # centroids <- pca.df %>%
    #   dplyr::group_by(annotation) %>%
    #   dplyr::summarise(
    #     PC_1 = mean(PC_1),
    #     PC_2 = mean(PC_2)
    #   ) %>%
    #   data.frame()
    # 
    # if (denoise) {
    #   title <- "After denoising"
    # } else {
    #   title <- "Before denoising"
    # }
    # 
    # p <- ggplot(pca.df, aes(PC_1, PC_2)) +
    #   geom_point(
    #     aes(color = annotation),
    #     size = 0.5,
    #     alpha = 0.1
    #   ) +
    #   stat_ellipse(
    #     aes(color = annotation),
    #     level = 0.68,
    #     linewidth = 1
    #   ) +
    #   geom_point(
    #     data = centroids,
    #     aes(PC_1, PC_2, color = annotation),
    #     size = 3,
    #     shape = 18
    #   ) +
    #   ggtitle(title) +
    #   labs(color = "Cell type") +
    #   predicted.annotation_l2.w.qc.legend.labels +

}
```

# DEGs per cell type, tumor-adjacent vs distal
High-quality only
```{r}
# high-quality only
downsample <- F

seurat.obj.gbm$location.grouped <- sapply(seurat.obj.gbm$location, function(x) ifelse(
  x %in% c("Core", "Edge"), "Core/Edge", x
))
Idents(seurat.obj.gbm) <- "location.grouped"

markers.all.df <- data.frame()
for (cell.type.of.interest in c("Astrocytes", "Excitatory neurons", "Inhibitory neurons", "Lymphoid", "Myeloid", "Oligodendrocytes", "OPC", "Vascular")) { 
  
  print(cell.type.of.interest)
  
  if (downsample) {
    seurat.obj.subset <- subset(seurat.obj.gbm, subset = (predicted.annotation_l2.w.qc == cell.type.of.interest), downsample = 100)
  } else {
    seurat.obj.subset <- subset(seurat.obj.gbm, subset = (predicted.annotation_l2.w.qc == cell.type.of.interest))
  }
  
  markers <- FindMarkers(object = seurat.obj.subset, 
                         ident.1 = "Core/Edge", 
                         ident.2 = "Distal",
                         test.use = "MAST",
                         min.pct = 0.1,
                         logfc.threshold = 0.25,
                         latent.vars = c("heat.shock.signature", "postmortem.sensitive", "postmortem.signature", "patient.desc"))
  
  markers$gene <- rownames(markers)
  markers$cell_type <- cell.type.of.interest
  markers.all.df <- rbind(markers.all.df, markers)
}


write.table(markers.all.df, paste0(figures.dir, "tumor_distal_DEG_analysis/", "DEGs_by_cell_type_core_edge_vs_distal_dowsample=", downsample, ".tsv"), quote = F, sep = "\t", row.names = F, col.names = T)
```



# Main: Tumor-adjacent vs distal 
```{r}
markers.all.df <- read.csv(paste0(figures.dir, "tumor_distal_DEG_analysis/", "DEGs_by_cell_type_core_edge_vs_distal_dowsample=", downsample, ".tsv"), sep = "\t")

# number of cells per cell type (for x-axis labels)
cell_counts <- seurat.obj.gbm@meta.data %>%
  count(predicted.annotation_l2.w.qc) %>%
  deframe()


# DEGs up
markers.filter.up <- markers.all.df %>% 
  filter(avg_log2FC > 0.5, p_val_adj < 0.05) %>% 
  group_by(cell_type) %>% 
  summarize(count = n()) %>% 
  mutate(Direction = "Up")
markers.filter.up <- markers.filter.up %>% arrange(desc(count))
markers.filter.up$cell_type <- factor(markers.filter.up$cell_type, levels = unique(markers.filter.up$cell_type)) # order decreasing

p.up <- ggplot(markers.filter.up, aes(cell_type, count, fill = cell_type)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  cell.types.anotation_l2.w.quality.fill.scale +
  xlab("Cell type") +
  ylab("Number of DEGs") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(fill = "Cell type") +
  ggtitle("Up") +
  scale_x_discrete(
    labels = function(x) {
      paste0(x, "\n(n = ", cell_counts[x], ")")
    }
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")


# DEGs down
markers.filter.down <- markers.all.df %>% 
  filter(avg_log2FC < -0.5, p_val_adj < 0.05) %>% 
  group_by(cell_type) %>% 
  summarize(count = n()) %>% 
  mutate(Direction = "Down")
markers.filter.down <- markers.filter.down %>% arrange(desc(count))
markers.filter.down$cell_type <- factor(markers.filter.down$cell_type, levels = unique(markers.filter.down$cell_type)) # order decreasing

p.down <- ggplot(markers.filter.down, aes(cell_type, count, fill = cell_type)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  cell.types.anotation_l2.w.quality.fill.scale +
  xlab("Cell type") +
  ylab("Number of DEGs") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(fill = "Cell type") +
  ggtitle("Down") +
  scale_x_discrete(
    labels = function(x) {
      paste0(x, "\n(n = ", cell_counts[x], ")")
    }
  )

p <- (p.up | p.down) 

if (downsample) {
  pdf(paste0(figures.dir, "cell_type_vs_number_of_DEGs_up_and_down_downsample.pdf"), width = 16, height = 8)
  print(p)
  dev.off()
} else {
  pdf(paste0(figures.dir, "cell_type_vs_number_of_DEGs_up_and_down.pdf"), width = 16, height = 8)
  print(p)
  dev.off()
}
```

# Supplemental: InferCNV by sample
```{r}
run.infercnv <- T

if (run.infercnv) {
  seurat.obj <- readRDS(paste0(root.dir, "ProcessedData/", "my_data/", "autopsy/", "all_postmortem_samples_cellbender.FALSE_denoise.heat.shock.signature_postmortem.sensitive_postmortem.signature_filter.FALSE_batch.correction.None/", "seurat_objects/all_postmortem_samples_w_celltypes.velmeshev2019.RDS"))
  
  sample.id.use <- "all_oligodendrocytes" # "all_patients_all_samples_facs_high_quality" or "all_patients_all_samples" or "all_oligodendrocytes"
  
  
  if (sample.id.use == "all_oligodendrocytes") {
    predictions.df <- read.csv(paste0(root.dir, "ProcessedData/", "Classifier/", "output/", "my_data_predictions.tsv"), sep = "\t", row.names = 1)
    seurat.obj <- AddMetaData(seurat.obj, predictions.df)
    seurat.obj$celltype.final <- apply(seurat.obj@meta.data, 1, function(row) ifelse(as.logical(row[["low.quality.by.qc"]]), row[["labels_initial"]], row[["predicted.annotation_l2"]]))

    seurat.obj.infercnv <- subset(seurat.obj, subset = predicted.annotation_l1 != "Malignant cluster")
    
    seurat.obj.infercnv$downsample <- T
    Idents(seurat.obj.infercnv) <- "downsample"
    
    # predicted oligodendrocytes
    seurat.obj.infercnv.malignant <- subset(seurat.obj.infercnv, subset = (celltype.final == "Oligodendrocytes") | (celltype.final == "Glial" & predicted.annotation_l2 == "Oligodendrocytes"))
    seurat.obj.infercnv.non.malignant <- subset(seurat.obj.infercnv, subset = (predicted.annotation_l2 != "Oligodendrocytes") & (low.quality.by.qc == FALSE))
    
    n.downsample <- dim(seurat.obj.infercnv.malignant)[2]
  } else {
    if (sample.id.use == "all_patients_all_samples_facs_high_quality") {
      # FACS and high-quality
      seurat.obj.infercnv <- seurat.obj.facs
      seurat.obj.infercnv <- subset(seurat.obj.infercnv, subset = low.quality.by.qc == FALSE)
    } else if (sample.id.use == "all_patients_all_samples") {
      seurat.obj.infercnv <- seurat.obj
    }
    
    seurat.obj.infercnv$downsample <- T
    Idents(seurat.obj.infercnv) <- "downsample"
    
    seurat.obj.infercnv.malignant <- subset(seurat.obj.infercnv, subset = predicted.annotation_l1 == "Malignant cluster")
    n.downsample <- dim(seurat.obj.infercnv.malignant)[2]
    
    seurat.obj.infercnv.non.malignant <- subset(seurat.obj.infercnv, subset = predicted.annotation_l1 != "Malignant cluster")
  }
  
  
  seurat.obj.infercnv.malignant.downsample <- subset(seurat.obj.infercnv.malignant, subset = downsample == TRUE, downsample = n.downsample)
  seurat.obj.infercnv.non.malignant.downsample <- subset(seurat.obj.infercnv.non.malignant, subset = downsample == TRUE, downsample = n.downsample)
  seurat.obj <- merge(seurat.obj.infercnv.malignant.downsample, seurat.obj.infercnv.non.malignant.downsample)
  seurat.obj[["RNA"]] <- JoinLayers(seurat.obj[["RNA"]])
  
  print("dim(seurat.obj) for infercnv")
  print(dim(seurat.obj))
  
  
  # clusters to use for inferCNV
  if (sample.id.use == "all_oligodendrocytes") {
    seurat.obj$cluster <- apply(seurat.obj@meta.data, 1, function(row) ifelse(row[["predicted.annotation_l2"]] == "Oligodendrocytes",
                                                                            paste0("Oligo_", row[["sample.desc"]]), 
                                                                            row[["predicted.annotation_l2"]]))
    all.clusters <- sort(unique(seurat.obj$cluster))
    malignant.clusters <- all.clusters[startsWith(all.clusters, "Oligo")]
  } else {
    seurat.obj$cluster <- apply(seurat.obj@meta.data, 1, function(row) ifelse(row[["predicted.annotation_l1"]] == "Malignant cluster",
                                                                            paste0("Malignant_", row[["sample.desc"]]), 
                                                                            row[["predicted.annotation_l1"]]))
    all.clusters <- sort(unique(seurat.obj$cluster))
    malignant.clusters <- all.clusters[startsWith(all.clusters, "Malignant")]
  }
  
  normal.clusters <- setdiff(all.clusters, malignant.clusters)
  
  
  count.matrix.infer.cnv <- seurat.obj@assays$RNA$counts
  print(dim(count.matrix.infer.cnv))
  
  # create annotations file and output directory
  annotations.df <- data.frame(cell=colnames(seurat.obj), annotation=seurat.obj$cluster)
  
  
  # create annotations file and infercnv output folder
  normal.clusters.label <- paste0(normal.clusters, collapse=".")
  
  
  infercnv.output.dir <- paste0(supp.figures.dir, "inferCNV/", sample.id.use, "_inferCNV/")
  dir.create(infercnv.output.dir, showWarnings = TRUE)
  print(infercnv.output.dir)
  
  annotations.file.path <- paste0(infercnv.output.dir, sample.id.use, '_infer.cnv.annotations.file.tsv')
  write.table(annotations.df, annotations.file.path, sep="\t", row.names=F, col.names=F, quote=F)
  
  # create infercnv object
  infercnv_obj = CreateInfercnvObject(raw_counts_matrix=count.matrix.infer.cnv,
                                      annotations_file=annotations.file.path,
                                      gene_order_file=paste0(root.dir, "ExternalData/hg38_gencode_v27.txt"),
                                      ref_group_names=normal.clusters)
  
  
  # run default analysis
  infercnv_obj_default = infercnv::run(
    infercnv_obj,
    cutoff=1, 
    out_dir=infercnv.output.dir,
    cluster_by_groups=T, 
    analysis_mode='samples',
    HMM_type='i6',
    plot_steps=FALSE,
    denoise=T,
    HMM=F, 
    no_prelim_plot=FALSE,
    png_res=300,
    save_rds = FALSE,
    save_final_rds = FALSE
  )
}
```
